run_sphere_optimization: run the sphere function to compute x squared plus y squared using Hydra and Optuna sweeper
run_sphere_with_error: run the sphere function with error flag set to true to simulate a RuntimeError exception
review_sphere_function: review the sphere function that takes x and y from Hydra config and returns x squared plus y squared
refactor_sphere_config: refactor the sphere function to use different config parameters or add additional optimization variables
test_sphere_optuna_sweeper: test the sphere function with Optuna TPE sampler across 20 trials minimizing x squared plus y squared
